termsAndConditions.en: Offers available to select customers only and is non-transferable. Customer must be an active DIRECTV account holder in good standing. Accounts placed on hold at the request of the account holder and accounts which are suspended are ineligible for offers during hold or suspend period. Any offers made ineligible during hold or suspend period will not be applied to future bills.

description.en: Enjoy up to 90 out-of-market games a week, including up to 99% of those in HD. Plus, you also get access to games on your phone, tablet or computer through MLB.tv, now included in your subscription.
